subject: The 3AM thought that started this
preview_text: I don't usually write emails like this, but here's the raw truth about building Fresh Start during my own breakup.
body_paragraphs: Three months ago, at 3AM, I was staring at my ceiling, heart racing, replaying every memory. That night, I didn't open a therapist app—I opened a notes app and typed: 'Why does it feel like I'm dying?' That was the first line of code for Fresh Start. I don't usually write emails like this, but I need you to know this app isn't a product to me—it's a survival tool I built when I couldn't sleep, couldn't eat, couldn't stop obsessing.

Healing isn't linear, and you probably already know that. Some days you feel strong, others you're back in that spiral. What I didn't expect was how much the small rituals would save me. The no-contact streak tracker? I set it at 4AM after texting my ex. The mood tracking? I marked 'angry' and 'hopeless' for a week straight before I saw a glimmer of 'okay.' That's why this exists—to catch you when you're at your lowest, not just when you're ready to move on.

I added Emergency Mode at 2AM one night because I needed someone to talk to without judgment. It's still there for you when the spiral hits. And the guided journaling prompts? They're the words I wish someone had said to me. You don't have to use every feature—just open the app when you need a lifeline. Even if it's just to see your mood chart go from 'broken' to 'healing' over time.

Open Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy now and try the 3AM SOS feature—one deep breath exercise I still use. P.S. My recovery started when I stopped waiting for them to reach out. That no-contact streak? It's for you, not them.
